died.name: George Plantagenet, Duke of Clarence
died.cause: The 1st Duke of Clarence was allegedly executed by drowning in a barrel of Malmsey wine, apparently his own choice once he accepted he was to be killed.

died.name: Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa
died.cause: to his black dog (allegedly his familiar)
died.last_words: Begone thou wretched beast, which hast utterly undone me.

died.name: Martin Luther
died.desc: German theologian who started the Protestant Reformation
died.last_words: We are beggars, this is true.

died.name: Lavinia Fisher
died.last_words: If any of you have a message for the devil, give it to me, for I am about to meet him!

died.name: John Bartholomew Gough
died.cause: The inaudible final word may have been "clean"

born.name: Mary I
born.cause: French forces had captured Calais from England earlier that year
born.last_words: After I am dead, you will find Calais written upon my heart.

born.name: George Peabody
born.last_words: It is a great mystery, but I shall know all soon.

born.name: Lewis Armistead
born.desc: Confederate brigadier general of the American Civil War
born.cause: prior to being mortally wounded at the Battle of Gettysburg
born.last_words: Give them the cold steel, boys.

born.name: O. O. McIntyre
born.last_words: Snooks, will you please turn this way? I like to look at your face.

born.name: George Gipp
born.cause: to Knute Rockne while dying of pneumonia
born.last_words: Some day, when things look real tough for Notre Dame [Notre Dame Fighting Irish football], ask the boys to go out there and win one for the Gipper.

born.name: Amir-Abbas Hoveyda

born.last_words: It wasn't supposed to end like this.
